sec: Biopsy & IF: MCD, IgM Nephropathy, FSGS

items.q: In MCD, biopsy (light microscopy, PAS) and immunofluorescence are both:
items.exp: Biopsy: normal; IF: normal (light microscopy: normal glomerulus, PAS stain). (Book p766)

items.q: IgM nephropathy, a variant of MCD, shows mesangial matrix expansion on biopsy, IgM +ve on IF and:
items.exp: IgM nephropathy: variant of MCD; mesangial matrix expansion; IF IgM +ve; poor prognosis compared to MCD. (Book p766)

items.q: FSGS is associated with Apo L1 polymorphisms; the CKD figure written is:
items.exp: Associated with Apo L1 polymorphisms; 70% develop CKD by 10 years. (Book p766)

items.q: On the FSGS biopsy page, focal means <50% glomeruli involved, while segmental means:
opts: Only a portion of glomeruli involved
items.exp: Focal: <50% glomeruli involved; segmental: only a portion of glomeruli involved. (Book p766)

items.q: The sclerosis chain written for FSGS runs: podocyte lost in urine → podocytopenia → GBM synechiae with parietal epithelial cell →
items.exp: Eosinophilic hyaline material obliterating glomeruli: podocyte lost in urine → podocytopenia → GBM synechiae with parietal epithelial cell → sclerosis. (Book p766)

items.q: IF in FSGS shows focal IgM ± C3; in 2° FSGS the IF is:
items.exp: IF: focal IgM ± C3; 2° FSGS: IF negative. (Book p766)

items.q: The FSGS treatment ladder uses steroid 1 mg/kg/day for how long before declaring SRNS?
items.exp: Steroid (1 mg/kg/day) → 4 months → if no response: SRNS → CNI/MMF → CKD → transplant. (Book p766)

items.q: Even after the kidney is replaced, the book warns that the disease can come back as:
items.exp: Even after transplant, recurrence can occur: transplant recurrence FSGS. (Book p766)

items.q: Which IF statement is TRUE as per this page?
opts: 2° FSGS is IF negative while primary FSGS shows focal IgM ± C3
FSGS IF is linear IgG along the GBM
items.exp: Focal IgM ± C3 in FSGS; 2° FSGS IF negative; MCD IF normal; IgM +ve belongs to IgM nephropathy. (Book p766)

items.q: Match each entity with its IF/biopsy signature — 1) MCD 2) IgM nephropathy 3) Primary FSGS … A) Focal IgM ± C3 B) Normal biopsy and IF C) Mesangial matrix expansion with IgM +ve
items.exp: MCD normal; IgM nephropathy mesangial expansion + IgM; FSGS focal IgM ± C3. (Book p766)

items.q: The light-microscopy figure labels on this page include normal glomerulus (PAS), IgM nephropathy and segmental sclerosis; the odd one out not labelled here is:
items.exp: Labels: normal glomerulus (PAS), IgM nephropathy, FSGS with segmental sclerosis; spikes belong to the MN pages. (Book p766)
